svg.data-weight-note: 14.53 kg (32.03 lb), with 2 PSUs and 7 fans installed
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (front-to-back, at 6000 ft); 0 to 35 C (back-to-front)
svg.data-bmc: AST2620 running OpenBMC, secured by an AST1060 root of trust
svg.data-software: ONIE preloaded; no NOS image ships on the device
svg.data-optics-osfp: datasheet: each port takes 1 x 800 GbE at 106 Gb/s PAM4, or breaks out to 2 x 400G, 4 x 200G or 8 x 100G. At 50 Gb/s PAM4 it takes 1 x 400G or breaks out to 2 x 200G, 4 x 100G or 8 x 50G; at 25 Gb/s NRZ it takes 1 x 100G. Maximum 160 logical ports.
